mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_templates WHERE category = #{category} AND is_active = 1 ORDER BY sort_order ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_templates (category, name, code, preview_url, config, is_vip_only, price_cents, is_active, sort_order) VALUES (#{category}, #{name}, #{code}, #{previewUrl}, #{config}, #{isVipOnly}, #{priceCents}, #{isActive}, #{sortOrder})
